summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved #373/#377 plan: missing compose files fall back to label-scoped volume teardown, genuine no-resource cleanup remains idempotent, ComposeOperationError reason codes are preserved, and post-merge filesystem GC now receives a volume-removing compose_teardown callback so the GC engine gates path deletion on teardown failure. Focused pytest, ruff, mypy, and documented substitute focused coverage evidence are present; full AWF/GitHub validation remains owned by the post-agent validation phase.
